patterns.note: Full-bleed video hero section with large, centered white text overlay, followed by content sections with a mix of centered text blocks and multi-column grids.
Headings use a bold, wide sans-serif typeface for impact, while body text uses a more neutral sans-serif. Small, uppercase labels are used for calls to action and sub-headings.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently accented by a vibrant, almost neon pink for links, graphic elements, and some background overlays, creating a playful yet bold feel.

The hero section features a full-bleed video background that subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of depth. The scroll-down indicator in the hero likely has a subtle animation (e.g., bounce or fade).
Service offerings are presented in a grid of cards featuring distinctive line-art illustrations, a concise title, and a call-to-action link.
The 'Snask Feed' section uses a dynamic, masonry-like grid for project showcases, with some cards featuring full-bleed images and others having a pink overlay or text-only content.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-width, full-height video element positioned behind the main content, with a subtle parallax effect applied to its background position as the user scrolls, giving the impression of depth. Text is overlaid in white for contrast.
Navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport without changing its appearance or size as the user scrolls.

Content sections below the hero appear to load statically or with a simple fade-in as they enter the viewport, without complex staggered animations, relying on the hero's motion for initial engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, readable sans-serif body text and even smaller uppercase labels for links and sub-headings.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on some card elements and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with generous vertical spacing in the hero and between major sections, and tighter spacing within content grids.

standout: This site stands out with its high-energy, full-bleed video hero that immediately conveys a dynamic brand personality. The playful yet bold use of a vibrant pink accent color, combined with distinctive line-art illustrations for service cards, creates a memorable and unique aesthetic for a creative agency.
